fact: The Zambia Bureau of Standards says stakeholders can access draft standards for public comment on its website, download supporting files and use an official public enquiry comments form, with 37 drafts currently uploaded for review.

Zambia's government told the World Bank's GovTech survey (2025) that portal.citizensupport.gov.zm is a national platform allowing citizens to take part in policy decision-making; the year is the survey round's, the record gives none.
ZICTA's public notice of 21 October 2026 puts its draft revised ICT (Type Approval) Guidelines on its website and invites written comments through an online comment form until 20 November 2026.
